title: GTFS Database Schema Documentation
summary: Complete SQLite schema reference for GTFS static data, learning tables, views, bootstrap process, and query examples.
notes: Reads as a prose/tutorial reference guide (Overview, Bootstrap Process, Maintenance, References sections) rather than a formal spec, but contains concrete CREATE TABLE schemas, FK constraints, and data model definitions that function as implementation contracts. Classified SPEC over DOC due to schema/data-model dominance, though tutorial structure creates ambiguity.
